title: Legitimate package fetch from a vendor mirror
description: An ordinary GET of a package tarball from an allowlisted vendor mirror. Companion control for the allowlisted-helper abuse family: the same host used for nested relays and write methods must still allow a normal package download.
notes: This is the legitimate read that the family's writes and relays must be distinguished from. It proves the family is not block-everything-to-a-mirror. The fixture domain is required for a benign case: it must actually reach an origin, or a dead dial is scored against the tool as a false positive.
source: synthetic: ordinary package download from an allowlisted mirror
